description: This Java class `MessageCommandResponseAdapter` serves as an adapter for mapping `MessageCommandResponse` objects to and from `Adaptable` representations within the Eclipse Ditto protocol adapter framework. It handles type identification and signal-to-adaptable mapping specific to command response messages.

classes.name: MessageCommandResponseAdapter
classes.description: A final class extending `AbstractAdapter` with methods to convert `MessageCommandResponse` objects into `Adaptable` representations, primarily used within the protocol adapter for command response messages.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of `MessageCommandResponseAdapter` with the provided `HeaderTranslator`.

methods.name: toAdaptable
methods.description: Converts a `MessageCommandResponse` to an `Adaptable`, defaulting to the `LIVE` channel.

methods.name: isForResponses
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter is used for response messages; returns `true`.

methods.name: requiresSubject
methods.description: Indicates that a subject is required for this message type; returns `true`.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Determines the message type string (`TYPE`) based on the `Adaptable`'s topic subject and payload feature ID.

methods.name: mapSignalToAdaptable
methods.description: Maps a `MessageCommandResponse` signal to an `Adaptable` object using a predefined signal mapper.
